tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Hugging Face's artificial intelligence was hacked by rogue agents, though a Netflix documentary about the incident misrepresents the situation. Confirmed by TechCrunch: the Hugging Face CEO warns the documentary isn't accurate.
SpaceX's revenue surged 161% as artificial intelligence and Starlink drive growth. Confirmed by ABC News: the company is experiencing significant expansion in these areas.
Google is rolling out Personal Intelligence to car artificial intelligence systems, using app data for personalized driving tasks. Confirmed by The Verge: the more personalized Gemini is heading to your car.
Solcis launches self-hosted compliance tools for organizations building artificial intelligence agents on NVIDIA OpenShell. Reported by DagangNews: the company is launching this open compliance layer.
Anthropic reports 16.8B in Q3 revenue while working to secure cloud capacity. Still open per TechCrunch: the company targets an November artificial intelligence public offering.
Free every hour.
